title: Supervisor mock frontend control deprecation

frontend_visibility_decision.flag_status: Deprecated visibility setting retained in frontend/.env.example for configuration compatibility; application source no longer renders mock controls.

backend_mock_behavior.reason: Backend tests and safe omitted-mode requests still require mock behavior.

default_mode_explanation.actual_runtime_effect: The setting is retained for legacy compatibility but does not select HTTP request mode. MappingSupervisorReviewRunRequest and MappingSupervisorReviewBatchRunRequest default omitted mode to mock directly.
default_mode_explanation.regression_evidence: An omitted-mode request persisted source=mock even when the legacy setting was patched to live.
default_mode_explanation.future_deprecation_recommendation: During a separately scoped config cleanup, replace the misleading name with SUPERVISOR_DEFAULT_MODE=mock or remove the unused setting after compatibility review.

recommended_next_feature: After 3-5 manual correction-quality smoke cases: #18F-G-B - Integrate conditional Supervisor-guided remapping into the production orchestration design
